site_account.title: Marrow Analytics: see every site in one place
site_account.description: Trial data software for mid-size biotech sponsors. One dashboard for every site, with enrollment problems flagged before they cost you a quarter.
site_account.markdown:
# See every site in one place

Marrow pulls data from your EDC, CTMS and site portals into one dashboard. Enrollment, deviations and query backlogs per site, updated daily.

## Built for sponsors with 50 to 200 people

No services team required. Connect your systems in a week and give your clinical operations lead a single screen.

## Catch enrollment problems early

Marrow flags sites that fall behind their enrollment curve and shows you why, so you can act before the study slips.

site_1.title: Trialdeck: clinical trial management for sponsors and CROs
site_1.description: Set up a study in days, not months. Site tracking, monitoring visits and documents in one suite.
site_1.markdown:
# Run every study from one suite

Trialdeck is clinical trial management software for sponsors and CROs of every size. Study setup, site activation, monitoring visits and the trial master file, in one place.

## Set up a study in days

Templates for protocols, sites and visit schedules get a new study running fast.

## From first-in-human to phase 3

Teams of five and teams of five hundred run on Trialdeck.

site_2.title: Cohort Health Systems: the enterprise clinical data suite
site_2.description: EDC, CTMS and eTMF for global pharmaceutical companies. Validated, audited and deployed across more than forty countries.
site_2.markdown:
# The clinical data suite for global pharma

Cohort Health Systems delivers electronic data capture, trial management and the trial master file as one validated platform for large sponsors.

## Enterprise deployment

Dedicated implementation teams, multi-year agreements and 24-hour support in every region.

## Talk to our team

Request a consultation with an enterprise specialist.

site_3.title: Sitewise: scheduling and source documents for research sites
site_3.description: One tool for the site coordinator. Visit scheduling, source documents and stipends, priced per site. Sign up today.
site_3.markdown:
# Built for the site coordinator

Sitewise replaces the binder and the spreadsheet. Schedule visits, capture source documents and track stipends in one tool.

## Priced per site

One flat price per research site. Sign up online and start today.

## Loved by coordinators

No training needed. Most sites are live in an afternoon.

site_4.title: Verity Clinical: data management services for late-phase trials
site_4.description: Our data managers run your database build, cleaning and lock, on our own platform. For sponsors who want the work done, not just the tool.
site_4.markdown:
# Data management, done for you

Verity Clinical runs database build, data cleaning and database lock for sponsors in late-phase trials. Our platform is how we deliver it.

## Services first

A named data manager on every study. Our software is included, never sold alone.

## Trusted by large sponsors

We work with global pharmaceutical companies on phase 3 and post-marketing studies.

site_5.title: Pulsepoint Labs: enroll faster
site_5.description: Patient recruitment analytics for mid-size sponsors. See which sites enroll, which fall behind, and where to send the next patient.
site_5.markdown:
# Enroll faster

Pulsepoint Labs shows sponsors which sites enroll and which fall behind, with the reasons, so you can move patients and budget to where they work.

## One tool, one job

Pulsepoint does recruitment analytics and nothing else. It plugs into the EDC and CTMS you already run.

## For mid-size sponsors

Built for clinical operations teams at sponsors with ten to forty active studies.

site_6.title: Helix Oversight: risk-based monitoring for large sponsors
site_6.description: Central monitoring and inspection readiness for sponsors running global programs. Built with regulators in mind.
site_6.markdown:
# Monitoring built for inspection day

Helix Oversight gives large sponsors central monitoring, key risk indicators and an audit trail that stands up to a regulator.

## Risk-based by design

Focus monitoring visits on the sites that need them.

## For global programs

Used by sponsors running programs across Europe, the Americas and Asia.

data.headline: Where Marrow sits among six trial data software vendors, and the gap none of them fills
data.intro: We picked the six companies closest to Marrow. Each one is placed from what its own homepage says about who it sells to and what it sells. A position is a reading of how a company sells, not a measurement.

open_space.title: Mid-size sponsors who want the whole suite
open_space.why: Trialdeck sells its suite to everyone and Cohort sells its suite to global pharma only. Nobody sells a full suite built for sponsors with 50 to 200 people, which is where Marrow already has its dashboard customers. Marrow already holds the site data layer those sponsors would start from.
